cases.utterance: how many page events come from each device type?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT d.device_type, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM page_events pe JOIN devices d ON pe.device_id = d.device_id GROUP BY d.device_type ORDER BY event_count DESC

cases.utterance: what is the browser share across all devices?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT browser_type, COUNT(*) AS device_count FROM devices GROUP BY browser_type ORDER BY device_count DESC

cases.utterance: which URLs were visited the most?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT url, COUNT(*) AS visit_count FROM page_events GROUP BY url ORDER BY visit_count DESC

cases.utterance: how many page events were recorded per host?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT host, COUNT(*) AS event_count FROM page_events GROUP BY host ORDER BY event_count DESC

cases.utterance: which referrers drive the most traffic?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT referrer, COUNT(*) AS traffic_count FROM page_events GROUP BY referrer ORDER BY traffic_count DESC

cases.utterance: how many pipeline spans are ok versus error?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS span_count FROM pipeline_spans GROUP BY status ORDER BY span_count DESC

cases.utterance: what is the average span duration per domain?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT domain, AVG(duration_s) AS avg_duration_s FROM pipeline_spans GROUP BY domain ORDER BY avg_duration_s DESC

cases.utterance: what is the average value for each metric?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT name, AVG(value) AS avg_value FROM metric_samples GROUP BY name ORDER BY avg_value DESC

cases.utterance: how many metric samples are there for each kind?
cases.expected_sql: SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS sample_count FROM metric_samples GROUP BY kind ORDER BY sample_count DESC
